title: Riverboat band personnel
summary: Asked about Armstrong, he names the boat's leader and musicians, including the piano player and drummer Zutty Singleton.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Is Armstrong still on the boat then?
No, sir. When I got on the boat, Eddie Allen from St. Louis had charge of the boat. That's Eddie Allen. Sidney Desvind.
Yes, sir. As Mason and White Bailey. I can't think of it. And Thomas was playing saxophones. Harvey playing trombone from St. Louis.
Who was the piano player? Was Faith?
Faith. Faith. Fred Marlowe. And the drummer, a fellow called Zully. That's all I know. Cason, Cason went up and Zully came on afterwards. After he came back to New Orleans.
Singleton. Arthur Singleton. That's his name.
He's in New York now. Yeah.
